integrity: Universal statements are justified by the analytic proof. Rational checks support but do not replace it. The source date is the earliest precisely verified public day for the focal continuous-time mixing source.
scientific_limitations: Equal community sizes and two constant positive price classes; independent individual nonnegative edge conductances. title: Distinct investment thresholds for resistance and fastest mixing in a two-community complete network
